scope: Source and local persistent SQLite validation of atomic paged native SQL catalog writes; not deployed large Bunny catalog acceptance
validated_cases: 1200-record bucket commits once across more than 1000 SQL statements
Bucket payload over 4 MiB round-trips without truncation
Same immutable receipt retried from newer snapshot returns recorded revision
Later-page SQL constraint failure rolls back all earlier pages
Later stale destination guard restores source deleted on preceding pages
Lost page response never commits; server stream expiry rolls back uncommitted data
Lost COMMIT response reconciles through receipt without duplicate rewrite
Oversized later statement rolls back earlier pages
limitations: Single statements still must fit bounded transport
Whole-bucket planning and existing per-bucket read/receipt metadata limits remain
Lost rotated baton may leave uncommitted locks until server stream expiry
Full nonempty migration, durable jobs and production large-catalog capacity remain open
